title: Ardleevan | Chapel Farm Premium Dog Food for Working Dogs
description: Ardleevan is the Northern Ireland and Ireland distributor of Chapel Farm Premium Dog Food — hypoallergenic, naturally preserved diets for working, competition and companion dogs.

hero.eyebrow: Sole NI stockist of the complete Chapel Farm range
hero.heading: Premium nutrition for working dogs
hero.lede: Chapel Farm Premium Dog Food, developed by multiple award-winning gundog trainer David Lisett and fed at the Buccleuch Gundog Kennels. Quality ingredients, no fillers, no bulking agents.

about.heading: About Ardleevan
body: I have been a keeper of working Labradors for half my life, and a breeder of Fox Red Labradors.

I had always struggled to find premium-quality dog food at an affordable price, with quality ingredients and none of the fillers and bulking agents found in a lot of the commercially available dog foods. After years of research, trial and error, I discovered a food developed by the world-famous, highly regarded and multiple award-winning David Lisett. Chapel Farm Premium dog foods are second to none in my opinion.

I have been lucky enough to be appointed distributor for Ireland of this amazing quality dog food. I have had amazing results with my own dogs, and countless other customers have had very good results with Chapel Farm Puppy Junior for pups under eight months of age.
My adult dogs are on Chapel Farm Performance 24+, the highest quality hypoallergenic dog food I have ever used. The coats and condition of my dogs are always commented on.

quote.text: To have a happy dog it needs to be a healthy dog. What I feed our dogs is of paramount importance for both their well-being and their performance. The dogs have never looked so well since being fed the diets in the Chapel Farm Premium Dog Food Range, and that is why I feed Chapel Farm dog food.

quality.heading: What goes into Chapel Farm Premium Dog Food?
body: All of the Chapel Farm Premium Dog Food ranges are free from BHA — we only use natural antioxidants to stabilise our feeds. The products are clear of any colour additives and all are naturally preserved.
Our chicken is great quality and fit for human consumption; the chicken used in the range does not include any feet, feathers or beaks from the animal carcass.

All pet foods contain EC-permitted additives such as vitamins and trace minerals which are essential to dogs and are therefore included in the range. The calcium content for each variety is between 1.2% and 2.0%.

points.title: Free from BHA
points.text: Natural antioxidants only — never artificial preservatives.

points.title: No colour additives
points.text: Nothing added for appearance. Naturally preserved throughout.

points.title: Human-grade chicken
points.text: No feet, feathers or beaks. Just quality meat protein.

points.title: Proven in the kennels
points.text: Fed at the Buccleuch Gundog Kennels and championship kennels.

chapelFarm.heading: Chapel Farm & the Buccleuch Kennels
chapelFarm.body: Chapel Farm is the home of the Buccleuch Kennels, situated on the Queensberry Estate in the Lowther Hills in Dumfries & Galloway. The kennels form part of a very versatile estate where you can enjoy a castle tour, mountain biking, fishing or shooting and much more.

buying.lede: This site is for information only — there is no online ordering. Get in touch and we will sort you out.
